review_description: Prompt attention to my query. I had 3 quotes for replacing my non functioning  solar system and all were over 10k which wasn't worth our while as we are likely to move in around 3 years. Mitch was the only person who suggested that we need only replace the inverter which we did and the system works fine. He also supplied and fitted a charger fofrmy new EV as well as carry out some smaller jobs eg replacing non functioning halogen downlights with LEDs.All jobs done to my satisfaction, at a good price and the services were done quickly and at the exact time they were promised. Nothing seemed to be too much trouble for the Company

The guys were very professional and it was a neat and tiday install.Very helpful with any questions and advice regarding the install. Have already recommended them to mates because of the install quality and how easy the installers were to communicate and deal with.

Great process from start to finish. Quotes obtained within a week and decision made, a couple of months waiting for the batteries to arrive and then all installed with minimal disruption in a day and a half. Mitch and Dieter were a pleasure to work with: lots of communication throughout the process, really invested in making sure we got exactly what we wanted, and had the app all set up for use prior to leaving. The end result is great would thoroughly recommend. Thanks very much.

I have to say a big thank you to Team Dieter and Mitch for my new 10.56kw solar system with 8kw inverter installation. All the conduit and cable works are neat and tidy.During the first site inspection, Dieter also explained to me clearly about new switchboard and mains cable upgrade is recommended for new solar system and potential battery installation in the future.I’m glad that I have upgraded my switchboard and mains cable at the same time as new solar system installed, it’s all to the standards now.Mitch showed me how to use the app to monitor the system, they are polite and punctual, tidy the worksite when the job is completed, they are hard working tradespeople.I highly recommend to anyone who wants to install their solar system or upgrade switchboard.

Mitch impressed us from the outset with how we could increase our solar energy and offered to redesign and retrofit our current panels plus finding room for another 11. No other company offered the same advice appearing only interested in selling larger batteries.  Both Mitch and Dieter worked very well: they were helpful, efficient, punctual and left the areasspotlessly clean spotless when they had finished.We would highly recommend Isolated Electrical.

Isolated electrical were a pleasure to deal with from start to finish. Time given to us to explain the best option for us was generously given and a follow up phone call from us with any questions was welcomingly received. The team were punctual each day and left the site clean and tidy. Top marks for customer service even to the point of offering to come and clean the solar panels monthly as we are living opposite a very dusty building site atm. Highly recommend

We are very happy with the job Isolated Electrical Qld has done. From first contact to the completion of the job their communication has been fantastic. The job entailed removal of and upgrades to inverter, power-board,  replacing redundant existing solar panels with new panels and increasing the number of panels. In addition to this Mitchell positioned the new panel to face north maximising on the solar energy. The install went ahead as scheduled and was completed within the timeframe they specified. The site was left tidy and we are very happy with their work.We have just received our first power bill since the install on the 22nd of Aug with image attached showing the solar credit for previous months and for August. WHAT A DIFFERENCE!We are very happy with the work Isolated Electrical QLD have done and thoroughly recommend them. Thank you Mitch and team.Louise and John at Salisbury
Very tidy installation. The crew was very safety conscious and even helped out with non-related issues.
Mitch and the team were friendly, helpful, respectful, turned up on time, did exactly what was asked for the quoted price and tidied up after themselves. Couldn’t ask for more.

Isolated Electrical were recommended to me by "word of mouth" as this is always the best way to decide whom to engage. The team at Isolated Electrical were at all times professional, knowledgeable and punctual. They responded promptly to any queries that I had and were able to explain clearly to answer my queries.I happily recommend the team at Isolated Electrical for your solar and EV charger install.
Friendly, timely, efficient and good communication. Helped all the way through the process, even provided photos of the finished product. Would definitely recommend to anybody.

The guys were1. On Time2. Engaged3. They explained everything and what our expectations should be yo help with the selection processWould always recommendThis teamReal tradesmanOld School and on the ballKeith Canning

We recently had Isolated Electrical install a 13.2kW solar system with a 10kW inverter on our roof, and we couldn’t be more impressed with the entire experience. From the first point of contact to final installation, the team was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly efficient.The installation was completed to the highest standard, with attention to detail and clear communication throughout. The crew arrived on time, worked diligently, and left everything clean and tidy. The system was up and running smoothly in no time, and we’re already seeing fantastic performance.At a price of $9,000, this installation represented outstanding value for money, especially considering the quality of workmanship and equipment provided. It’s clear that Isolated Electrical takes great pride in their work, and it shows in the results.We highly recommend Isolated Electrical to anyone considering solar. Their service is top-tier, their team is trustworthy and friendly, and the final product speaks for itself.

I recently had solar panels installed by Isolated Electrical Qld, and I couldn't be happier with the entire experience. From start to finish, the service was professional, efficient, and stress-free.Mitch and Dieter were absolutely fantastic—friendly, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about what they do. They took the time to explain everything in detail, answered all my questions honestly, and made sure I felt confident about the process. The installation was completed on time, with zero mess left behind, and everything was done to a high standard.Since the system was installed, I’ve already noticed a significant drop in my power bills. It feels great knowing I’m saving money and doing something positive for the environment.If you’re considering solar, I highly recommend Isolated Electrical Qld. You won’t find a better team than Mitch and Dieter—they truly went above and beyond!

We had an outstanding experience with Isolated from start to finish. The team was punctual, professional, and knowledgeable. They made the whole process simple and stress-free. They took the time to explain the system options, answered every question, and never once pushed for an upsell on something we didn’t need. The installation was completed a day quicker than they quoted and no mess left behind.Since going live, our solar system has performed better than expected and we’ve already noticed a big drop in our power bills. The boys are a great laugh and definitely enjoy each others company.

The team at Isolated Electrical were fantastic. From the moment I contacted them their communication was excellent, which is so rare. They arrived on time and completed the install promptly. Our solar system was great value for money and has almost completely wiped our electricity bills. Nothing has been too much trouble for the team they even returned to temporarily remove our panels for a renovation. We couldn’t be happier and would highly recommend Isolated electrical.
We’ve used Isolated Electrical on several projects and couldn’t be happier with their service – always reliable, professional, and easy to work with.

Mitch from Isolated Electrical was fantastic! He was friendly and answered all my questions! They were punctual, polite and cleaned up when they were done. I was very happy with the price too. Would recommend to family and friends!

Had a great experience with the team especially Mitch. Very easy to deal with and made everything easy to understand. Mitch was on site for the install and they kept the worksite tidy and the system was installed very quickly.

Had a great experience with Isolated Electrical QLD for our solar install. The quote was done quickly, and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. The team was super knowledgeable and easy to deal with—always quick to respond and happy to answer questions. They showed up on time, did a neat job, cleaned up after themselves, and were really personable. They even organised the grid connection afterwards, which made things so much easier. Great value and service—would definitely recommend!
